meta.name: databases
meta.description: Work with MongoDB (document database, BSON documents, aggregation pipelines, Atlas cloud) and PostgreSQL (relational database, SQL queries, psql CLI, pgAdmin). Use when designing database schemas, writing queries and aggregations, optimizing indexes for performance, performing database migrations, configuring replication and sharding, implementing backup and restore strategies, managing database users and permissions, analyzing query performance, or administering production databases.

copy.tagline: 设计数据库模式、编写查询并优化性能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理或优化 MongoDB 或 PostgreSQL 数据库
copy.tagline_en: Design database schemas, write queries, and optimize performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage or optimize MongoDB or PostgreSQL databases

howto.what: Claude 能帮你操作 MongoDB 和 PostgreSQL 数据库，包括设计表结构、写查询、优化索引、迁移数据、管理用户权限等。
howto.when: 当你需要设计数据库、写 SQL 或 MongoDB 查询、优化性能、迁移数据、配置备份或管理生产数据库时。

say.text: 帮我写一个 MongoDB 聚合管道，按用户分组统计订单金额。
say.note: Claude 会生成聚合管道代码。

say.text: 优化这条 PostgreSQL 查询，它跑得太慢了。
say.note: Claude 会分析并给出索引建议。

say.text: 生成一个数据库迁移脚本，给 users 表加一个 email 字段。

howto.what_en: Claude can help you work with MongoDB and PostgreSQL databases, including schema design, writing queries, optimizing indexes, performing migrations, managing users and permissions, and administering production databases.
howto.when_en: Use when designing database schemas, writing queries, optimizing performance, migrating data, configuring backups, or managing production databases.

say_en.text: Write a MongoDB aggregation pipeline to group orders by user and sum amounts.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the pipeline code.
Claude will analyze and suggest indexes.

say_en.text: Generate a migration script to add an email column to the users table.
say_en.note: Claude will output the migration script.
